name: attack-helicopter
title: Attack helicopter (mission 5 rig defenders)
usage: Mission 5: three helicopters defending the oil-rig complex (air targets). Pending independent safety review; not uploaded; not referenced from src/.

noText.note: No letters, numbers, call signs, serials, codes or glyph-like marks in mesh or texture; countershading, splinter camouflage, panel lines, plain grey intake slats and stains only.

noLogosOrBrands.note: No company, product or brand marks; colour fields and wear only.

noRealMilitaryInsignia.note: No roundels, flags, national or unit markings; the only marking is a plain dark-red fin-top band. Original design, not a copy of any real or game helicopter (narrow faceted tandem fuselage, one wide faired engine deck with side intakes, stub wings with tip pods, swept fin with a port tail rotor).

noFaces.note: No faces or figures: no crew is modelled and the canopy panes are opaque, tinted only slightly lighter and bluer than the paint, with body-colour frames. Head-on, both engines sit under one wide body-colour engine deck behind the pilot's canopy (no separate round nacelle fronts and no dark intake openings; the intakes face sideways), there is no chin turret, gun or sensor ball, and the nose is a plain pointed fairing. Checked in preview-front, preview-closeup-front, preview-closeup-front-3q, preview-front-low, preview-front-high and preview-closeup-canopy.

noSuggestiveShapes.note: Ordinary hard-surface or natural forms reviewed in all four previews.

noGoreOrWeaponsGlorification.note: No gun, rockets or missiles: the stub wings carry two small empty pylons each and smooth tip pods. No damage or gore.

originalDesign.note: Authored procedurally in tools/assets from original dimensions; no third-party meshes or scans.

MainRotor.note: Part origin is the hub; spin about the part's Y axis.

TailRotor.note: Part origin is the hub; spin about the part's X axis. On the helicopter's left (port) side, Roblox -X.

orientation: Nose at Roblox -Z. The tail rotor is on the left (port) side: Blender +X, Roblox -X.
design: Original tandem-seat attack helicopter: narrow faceted fuselage, stepped two-pane canopy (gunner front and low, pilot behind and high), one wide faired engine deck behind the pilot's canopy with side intake grilles, exhausts pointing sideways at its rear corners, stub wings with two empty pylons and a tip pod each, swept fin, low stabiliser, four-blade main rotor (MainRotor part) and four-blade tail rotor (TailRotor part). No gun, sensor ball or weapons.
sizeRationale: Fuselage 20.2 studs nose to tail, main rotor 20 studs across. At the fighters' ~1.44 studs per metre a 14 m attack-helicopter fuselage with a 14 m rotor gives these sizes: 0.77x the Vanta v2's 26.4-stud length and 0.81x its 24.6 span, so it reads as smaller than a fighter but large enough to hit.
